ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure shows an acyl azide-like structure: on the left, an R group is connected to the carbonyl carbon, and the carbonyl carbon is connected by a double bond to the oxygen atom above; the right side of the carbonyl carbon is connected by a single bond to a negatively charged nitrogen; this nitrogen is then connected by a single bond to a positively charged nitrogen; at the far right there is another nitrogen connected to the positively charged nitrogen by a multiple bond. There is also a curved arrow in the figure, but the problem requires ignoring the arrow. Reasoning: According to the problem statement, replace the R group with the wildcard atom *. The carbonyl part is written as *C(=O). The negatively charged nitrogen connected by a single bond after the carbonyl carbon is written as [N-]; then the positively charged nitrogen connected by a single bond is written as [N+]; the terminal nitrogen and this positively charged nitrogen are connected by a triple bond, written as #N. Combining gives SMILES: *C(=O)[N-][N+]#N.

raw_record.question_text: What is the SMILES expression of the transition-state structure shown in the image, ignoring the arrows?

method.method_draft: From the image, ignore the curved arrow as instructed. Replace the R group attached to the carbonyl carbon with '*'. Encode the carbonyl fragment as *C(=O), then append the singly bonded negatively charged nitrogen as [N-], the singly bonded positively charged nitrogen as [N+], and finally the triple-bonded terminal nitrogen as #N. Combine these in order to obtain *C(=O)[N-][N+]#N.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中显示一个酰基叠氮样结构：左侧为 R 基连接到羰基碳，羰基碳与上方氧原子双键相连；羰基碳右侧单键连接一个带负电的氮；该氮再单键连接到一个带正电的氮；最右端还有一个氮与带正电氮以多重键相连。图中还有一条弯箭头，但题目要求忽略箭头。
推理：按照题意将 R 基替换为通配原子 *。羰基部分写作 *C(=O)。羰基碳后接单键的带负电氮，写作 [N-]；再接单键的带正电氮，写作 [N+]；末端氮与该正电氮为三键，写作 #N。合并得到 SMILES：*C(=O)[N-][N+]#N。

planner_metadata.distinctiveness_rationale: Direct structure-to-SMILES transcription is the natural single route: identify the atoms, bonds, and formal charges from the drawing, ignore the curved arrow, and encode them in SMILES.
planner_metadata.image_role: Read the displayed transition-state skeleton as an acyl fragment R-C(=O)- attached to a negatively charged nitrogen, which is single-bonded to a positively charged nitrogen that is triple-bonded to a terminal nitrogen; also note the curved arrow is present but should not be encoded.
planner_metadata.text_role: Use the question instruction to produce a SMILES expression for the shown structure and to ignore arrows rather than interpreting them as reaction movement.
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: Use SMILES conventions: represent the unspecified R substituent as wildcard '*', carbonyl as C(=O), charged nitrogens as [N-] and [N+], single bonds by adjacency, and the N≡N triple bond by '#'.
